Unit tests for fd_flamenco_yaml serialization of type walks to YAML.

# Purpose
This file is a unit test program for the `fd_flamenco_yaml` serializer. It checks that a type-walk input, which describes a tree of values with levels, names, and scalar data, is converted into the expected YAML text. The file defines a small test data format with `fd_flamenco_type_step_t` and `fd_flamenco_yaml_test_t`, then builds a set of test cases that cover primitive values, maps, arrays, nested maps, nested arrays, mixed map and array structures, and `null` values.

The [`main`](<#main>) function sets up the runtime, attaches scratch memory, and runs each test in a scratch scope. Each test creates a `fd_flamenco_yaml_t` object with `fd_flamenco_yaml_init`, feeds the walk steps into `fd_flamenco_yaml_walk`, and compares the generated output with the expected YAML string. If the output does not match, the code logs the expected and actual text and stops with an error. If all tests pass, the program logs `pass`, checks that scratch memory is fully released, and shuts down.
